sections.title: Academic Medical Center AI (UW Medicine)
sections.description: UW Medicine (University of Washington Health Sciences, Seattle) — ranked consistently among the US's top 10 research medical centers.

blocks.heading: Pacific Northwest population health
paragraphs: ML for UW Medicine's large five-state patient population — Alaska, Idaho, Montana, and Wyoming are served by UW Medicine through distance health and regional referral programs that create specific telehealth-enabled population health AI requirements that other major academic medical centers don't address.

blocks.heading: Oncology precision medicine
paragraphs: ML for the Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center (UW-affiliated, merged with Seattle Cancer Care Alliance) — genomics-informed cancer treatment prediction, immunotherapy response modeling, and clinical trial analytics for one of the US's leading cancer research programs.

blocks.heading: Washington My Health MY Data Act compliance
paragraphs: All Seattle healthcare AI must be designed with WA MHMD Act compliance — Washington's consumer health data protections go beyond HIPAA in several significant ways, and UW Medicine's AI must navigate both federal HIPAA and Washington's stronger state health privacy framework.

sections.title: Washington State healthcare AI regulatory context
sections.description: Key regulatory considerations for healthcare AI development in Washington State.

blocks.heading: Washington My Health MY Data Act (WA MHMD Act)
paragraphs: Washington's consumer health data law applies to any entity that collects, shares, or sells consumer health data from Washington residents — including digital health tools, healthcare apps, and AI systems. WA MHMD Act requirements go beyond HIPAA in key areas: broader definition of 'health data,' stricter consent requirements, and stronger consumer rights. ClickMasters designs all Seattle healthcare AI with WA MHMD Act as a primary compliance requirement alongside HIPAA.

blocks.heading: 42 CFR Part 2 for substance use disorder
paragraphs: Washington's substance use disorder treatment programs are subject to 42 CFR Part 2's stricter-than-HIPAA confidentiality requirements for SUD treatment records — ClickMasters designs all Washington SUD AI with 42 CFR Part 2 compliance.
